definitions.explanation: Describes something extremely strong or intense in degree, often used for natural forces, emotions, speed, or effort. Conveys a sense of overwhelming power or severity.

examples.japanese: {猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いた→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
{猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦スピード→スピード：11048_supiido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{走|はし}り{抜|ぬ}けた。
examples.english: He sped through at a furious pace.

examples.japanese: {猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{九州|きゅうしゅう}→九州：15647_kyuushuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上陸|じょうりく}→上陸：20591_jouriku⟧し、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A violent typhoon made landfall in Kyushu, causing damage across the region.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily used as a na-adjective ({猛烈|もうれつ}な). Can also function adverbially as {猛烈|もうれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Describes intensity at an extreme level — stronger than ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧ in many contexts. Often used in weather reports and news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: fierce wind
- {猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧: intense heat
- {猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{勢|いきお}い→勢い：01782_ikioi⟧: tremendous force
- {猛烈|もうれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧: to oppose fiercely
- {猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧: violent typhoon
